name: The Border March & Forfeit Gap
act: Act II: The Mountain Pass & Ancient Overhang
description: An uneven frontier landscape stretching between two level chunks. Centered around a plateau hosting the Border Customs House, bounded by an eastern mountain pass and ancient 45-degree overhang ruin ramparts in the north.

primitives.name: Ancient 45-Degree Stepped Bastion
primitives.description: Cantilevered megalithic stone rampart obeying the 45-degree overhang rule. The ruin has no foundations below the seam.

primitives.name: Theodolite Station & Relic Cairn
primitives.description: Conical dry-stone cairn crowned with a bronze geodetic mounting post holding Surveyor Vellum's calibrated theodolite.

primitives.name: Orom's Literal Wish-Stone Slab
primitives.description: Monolithic quarried granite slab bridging chasm drops, chiseled with coarse runes and answered literally by Orom.

primitives.name: Frontier Cast-Iron Brazier
primitives.description: Octagonal cast-iron fire basin resting on tripod legs, burning charcoal embers to warm frontier guards.

primitives.name: Border Milestone Signpost
primitives.description: Weathered oak milestone post with directional arm pointing travellers toward the mountain pass.

primitives.name: R6-SHIP Standard Bounding Crate
primitives.description: Impounded freight containers stacked alongside the road approach.
